title: Jesus... I Shouted At My Little Sister Over A Charger
topic: he snapped at his little sister over a charger, then laughed it off and never apologised

bible.text: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I shouted at my little sister over a charger. I laughed it off. She's still not talking. 🔌

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: She closed her door softly. That was worse than slamming it.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It was only a charger. I had a bad day.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The charger wasn't the thing. You know that.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So I just say sorry like nothing happened?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Say it plainly. A small door opens wider than you think.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: His mercies never fail, and they are new for you today.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the sibling you owe an apology. What will you say to them tonight? 👇
